entities.summary: Olof Rydbeck was a Swedish diplomat. Rydbeck began his diplomatic career at the Swedish Ministry for Foreign Affairs in 1939, serving in Berlin, Ankara, and Washington, D.C., and holding roles such as acting second secretary and first secretary of legation. He later became head of division and chief of the Ministry's press bureau in 1952.
